title: Later: survey 3D/XR standards forums
description: Mark 2026-10-21: look at these forums later and decide whether to participate. Candidates: Metaverse Standards Forum (coordination body, reports not specs; check membership tiers and IPR terms), OMI group (W3C Community Group writing glTF extensions; check activity and real importer support per extension, e.g. Godot), Khronos glTF ecosystem (KHR extensions; issues, no membership needed), AOUSD (OpenUSD), W3C Immersive Web WG (WebXR), VRM Consortium (avatars). For each: what it produces, who implements it, relevance to JMAP Scene, cost in time, and IPR terms. Related: jmap-chat-spec-9k91 (Scene citations).
